cases.title: creates a new supplier with all required fields filled

steps.data: Logged in and navigated to Service Providers > Suppliers

steps.target: Company, Street Address, City, State, Contact Name, Phone Number, Email, Lead Time to US (Days)

steps.expected: Searching the new company name surfaces a row with the entered supplier name, "{state}, {country}" location, and contact name

cases.title: shows a validation error when Balance Timing is left blank

steps.target: all required fields except Balance Timing

steps.expected: "The balance payment timing field is required." validation banner is shown; no supplier is created

riskNotes: Balance Timing has no "*" in the UI but is required server-side — verified live, see project_conventions.md.

City is likewise unmarked but a NOT NULL DB column with no validation rule (an unhandled 500 debug page, not a graceful error) — deliberately not covered by an automated negative test; see requirements/service-providers-suppliers-create.md and project_conventions.md.

cases.title: shows a validation error when Company is left blank

steps.expected: "The company name field is required." validation banner is shown; no supplier is created

riskNotes: Confirmed live: unlike City, Company IS covered by a graceful validation rule (no 500) — verified before writing this test.
